title: Full-component extract of Crithmum maritimum and its effect on epidermal regeneration
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,1713-1720
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA04301D, Paper
Open Access

Hongbin Huang, Jin Qian, Lanlan Zeng, Jin Zhang, Xiaobo Peng, Xilong Tang, Yanzhang Tang, Meimei Fu, Qi Liu, Fengrui Song, Jinshan Guo, Zhihui Lu
By blending hexanediol with caprylic/capric triglyceride, we created a full-component extract of Crithmum maritimum, which could promote epidermal regeneration.
